author: Akien
prose: we have something like 20ish tickets closed overnight but we have 48 adjudications? after we said we werent going to do that anymore? reading them, we clearly do need to not silently close this. BUT everything is stopped now because this is not the intention. the intention is: I REVIEW THE ARTIFACT AFTER IT TRANSITS THE GATES. I REVIEW THE IDEA AS YOU'VE WRITTEN IT AFTER IT PASSES THE GATE. THE INTENTION. THE TICKETS. THATS WHERE I SIGN OFF ON IT NOW. THIS WILL GIVE US A BETTER VIEW INTO ANYTHING THE GATES ARE MISSING. THIS DOES NOT INCLUDE THE POST BUILD INSPECTOR OR PROBE CREATION STEPS, at least so far. THIS SHOULD RESULT IN FEWER QUESTIONS. WE MUST TAKE THIS AS A P0 ISSUE IMMEDIATELY. This does not mean we don't go thru these adjudications. but my inbox whatever the output of our script is to review each thing thats passed a gate, the actual text of it, before it goes on. So we /idea /sorted /sail that one, and I review the artifact (idea, intention, ticket) as it passes those stages. we will build this out now, then we will do the adjudications, then we will start reviewing tickets (p1s first: claude, skills, workflow, workflow support issues), then intentions (p1 tickets, then p1 intentions, then p1 ideas), then ideas. Then p2 issues in the same order: tickets, intentions, ideas. why: because the p0 and p1 things make you either faster or more reliable. and because the closer something is to ready to build, the better. so this gets the p1 things handled most quickly
